bibliographic.title: Dekugo Goes to Euphoria College
bibliographic.author: MaimasVerde
bibliographic.description:
Hey Everyone, I'm Maimas! Here's my game for The 2025 Bare-Bones Jam, it's called "Dekugo Goes to Euphoria College" (full screen def recommended)  [art by my good friend Maddisynne W.]

This is just the first chapter, but I wanted to get some feedback about story and gameplay structure (and I even feel weird calling it gameplay, seeing as it's pretty linear.

This game is a text-based My Hero Academia-Euphoria crossover AU (meaning alternate universe) adventure. It's fairly short, but diverting if I can say so myself.  An adventure about young man named Dekugo finding out about his past and help guide his future. It's part drama, part slice of life, part action (eventually), part romance, a lot of moving parts. Exciting!

Kind of a proof of concept, but moreso to just get this out since this is a passion project of mine. Tell me what you think and enjoy! Potential future updates??

TW: A little NSFW (just to be safe) language, upsetting imagery at times, mentions/allusions to self-harm, mild allusions to intimacy, intimacy, bullying, action and violence, and reference to violent crimes.
